aitmpl.description: Official MCP server of the aitmpl.com catalog: lets Claude search Claude Code components (agents, commands, skills, hooks, MCP servers, settings, loops, mods and plugins), read one with its full content and SkillSpector scan, and get the claude-code-templates command that installs it. Remote, read-only, no sign-in; it installs nothing itself, Claude runs the returned command.
